testPlan.title: Issue 26: undo of a smooth under a driving vehicle

test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: A vehicle is driving along a stretch of road
test.hint: AutoDrive: send a vehicle along a stretch of road and wait until it is on that stretch. Click pass when it is driving.

test.title: Smooth that stretch while the vehicle is on it
test.hint: Smooth tool on the stretch the vehicle is driving. Ticks itself from the log.

test.title: Undo once: the stretch goes back and the destinations are kept
test.passLog: undo or redo kept the destinations
test.hint: Undo once. The smoothed stretch goes back to its old points. Ticks itself from the log.

test.title: Redo once: the vehicle carries on without stopping or turning
test.hint: Redo once. The smoothed stretch comes back. Watch the vehicle: it should keep going on the old road with no stop and no swerve. Click pass if it does.

test.title: Once it is past, the held points go
test.hint: Let the vehicle drive past the stretch. Ticks itself from the log.
